mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, COALESCE(u.B_AMOUNT, 0) AS budget, COALESCE(u.SAVINGS_GOAL_AMOUNT, 0) AS goalAmount, COALESCE(u.SAVINGS_CURRENT_AMOUNT, 0) AS currentAmount, COALESCE(SUM(m.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS spent FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN MYTRANS m ON m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND m.TYPE = 'OUT' AND COALESCE(m.EXCLUDE_ANALYSIS, 'N') = 'N' AND m.TRANS_DATE >= to_date(#{yearMonth} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.TRANS_DATE < (to_date(#{yearMonth} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 month') WHERE u.STATUS = 'Y' AND u.SAVINGS_AUTO_FILL = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.B_AMOUNT, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(u.SAVINGS_GOAL_AMOUNT, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(u.SAVINGS_CURRENT_AMOUNT, 0) < u.SAVINGS_GOAL_AMOUNT AND (u.SAVINGS_GOAL_DATE IS NULL OR u.SAVINGS_GOAL_DATE >= to_date(#{yearMonth} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SAVINGS_AUTO_LOG l WHERE l.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND l.YEAR_MONTH = #{yearMonth}) GROUP BY u.USER_ID, u.B_AMOUNT, u.SAVINGS_GOAL_AMOUNT, u.SAVINGS_CURRENT_AMOUNT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SAVINGS_AUTO_LOG (USER_ID, YEAR_MONTH, AMOUNT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{amount}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, YEAR_MONTH) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET SAVINGS_CURRENT_AMOUNT = LEAST(SAVINGS_GOAL_AMOUNT, COALESCE(SAVINGS_CURRENT_AMOUNT, 0) + #{amount}) WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
